text:
sasha: Heads-up — planning a kernel swap + promoting the nightly quant build tonight. want a latchboard hold until perf/qa give thumbs. target window 20:00-23:00 UTC.

matt: ack. can we do 5% canary for 30m then ramp?

sasha: yes. plan: 5%/30m -> 20%/20m -> 100% if metrics green. latch engaged after canary pass for manual verification.

zara: adding rollback criteria: p99 token latency >15% over baseline OR request error rate increase >0.4% sustained for 10m = rollback. also any OOMs or kv-cache tailwind.

anil: +1. also if embedding accuracy drift >2% on the canary eval set rollback. I'll run the eval at canary start.

cheng: note about ABI: kernel v3.5 has a small ABI change for matmul kernels. ops already built compatibility shim, but we need to pin noncritical customers to v3.4 for 24h after rollout. can we add a tag to the rollout?

sasha: yes — we'll set a pin TTL for legacy-tenants of 24h. add to release notes and notify customer success.

deploybot: Swap job queued by @sasha. Command:```/deploy swap runtime-kernel:3.4 -> runtime-kernel:3.5 --canary 5% --latch```Latch engaged: true. ETA start 2024-08-01 20:00 UTC.

qa-bot: preflight smoke results: all unit-smoke green on staging, latency baseline vs canary sim within 3%. full canary smoke scheduled at start time.

matt: checklist for post-canary manual checks (short):
- traces: p99 tail stable
- qps-serving distribution checks
- no sign of increased eviction on KV cache
- quick overlay: `kubectl logs -l app=runtime -n prod --tail 200 | grep OOM`

zara: release notes blurb draft: "runtime-kernel v3.5: optimized matmul kernels, improved KV cache locality, quant build promotion (nightly -> verified). Note: small ABI tweak; legacy customers may be pinned for 24h." link: https://internal.redwood/release-notes/runtime-kernel-3.5 

anil: rollback command if needed:```/deploy rollback runtime-kernel --to 3.4 --reason "p99 regression"```. ops runbook also has fast-evict mitigation steps.

cheng: perf collectors to watch: `latency.p99.token`, `request.errors.rate`, `kv.evictions.count`, `mem.rss.gpu`. I'll instrument a temp dashboard and share.

sasha: tagging @zara @cheng to do final sign-off at T+35m canary. latch TTL set to 2h after canary completion. If no manual release, auto-unlatch and continue ramp.

deploybot: Latch engaged. TTL: 7200s. Canary traffic 5% scheduled. Job id: 6b7f3c. Will post canary smoke summary at 30m.

qa-bot: starting canary smoke now. running eval: `eval/canary/kv_quant_regressions` and `eval/canary/latency_suite`. ETA ~12m.

qa-bot: canary smoke: latency p99 delta +2.1%, error rate stable, eval drift 0.6% -> PASS. logs: `no OOMs`, `no segfaults`.

sasha: quick thumbs? @matt @cheng @zara

matt: thumbs. all checks green on prod traces.

cheng: dashboard looks good. mem stable, evictions unchanged. give go for 20% ramp.

zara: thumbs from QA. going to update release notes and ping cs.

deploybot: Ramp to 20% in progress. Will hold again at 20% for 20m for telemetry.

(small gap)

anil: after 20% hold I'm going to run a filtered eval targeting heavy-context prompts. will post results.

qa-bot: 20% hold complete; no anomalies in 20m window.

anil: heavy-context eval: drift 1.1% and latency delta within 6% - acceptable.

sasha: sounds good. we'll proceed to full ramp. ops: remember to notify CS about the 24h pin for legacy-tenants.

deploybot: Full ramp initiated. Job id: 6b7f3c -> completed. Latch will remain until manual release or TTL expiry (7200s from canary complete).

zara: small post-deploy note: watch for rare double-alloc pattern in logs (seen once in staging). if it recurs -> rollback.

qa-bot: post-deploy smoke: all green. publishing release note snippet and changelog entry.

sasha: thanks everyone. follow-up action items:
- @cheng share dash link in #eng-observability
- @zara update CS message and internal release note
- @anil run extended eval tonight (2h run) and report in morning
- ops: mark legacy-tenants pinned in billing config for 24h

matt: and we'll reconvene if any of the rollback criteria hit or if CS reports customer-facing issues.

deploybot: Latch still active. TTL expires at 1719469989. If you need earlier unlatch: `/deploy latch release 6b7f3c`

sasha: closing thread for now. ping here if anything unusual. :white_check_mark:
